item.tib: sgos sgrub kyi cha lag byin 'bebs bsam 'phel nor bu'i do shal
item.coloph: zhes 'di ltar dgos zhes lung rig smra ba'i rab 'byams pa shes rab grags pa rgyal mtshan dang bstan 'dzin kun khyab zung gis lha reg bcas nan tan gyis bskul ba mi bcag tsam du mkhan ming snang btsun shes blos 'bras ldan zla ba'i mar phyogs dga' ba gsum pa'i rgyal phur 'grub sbyor nyin shar mar bris pa smros nyes 'gal ba ci mchis thams cad skyabs yul dam pa rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ rnam dkar dge bas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs dang kun mkhyen rnam 'dren bla mas 'gro drug rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
